label: Every real determination of an actual root is realized by a real constituent of it
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (REAL): for every actual concrete root r at w and every determination t that r has at w, some real constituent k of r realizes t in r (r has t by k). Every real determination has a real constituent as its reality. It does not say that every constituent realizes some determination; a constituent that is a principle of limitation may realize none.
